answer: The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in ridge, expire in umber, and horizon lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 152 aliases as a result needs 53 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4861 identities would post 1909 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
